name: Chelsea Arcot
original_name: チェルシー・アーコット
source:
One of the Temple Knights sent from the Divine City Long Birth with the mission of protecting the several Artifacts that will be in exposition in Ert'Aria. Chelsea herself also has the additional mission of looking for the cause of a predicted disaster. Friend of Leicester's and Carina's parents.
Has a very strong duty sense and superb skill, but also terrible sense of direction, with almost 100% of probabilities of getting lost if alone. Also tends to use sword metaphors when talking.
